references.observed: Operator separates the main crossing, Serbian auxiliary plant, Romanian island locks and Gogoșu works. The main plant has sixteen units.
Serbian navigation chamber is 310 by 34 metres.
Published normal reservoir level is 41 m.
Road-level view shows the main cream concrete powerhouse ribs, dark windows and upstream steel beam line.
Serbian side road view shows ochre rails, smaller powerhouse, yellow gantries and raised crest lights.
Aerial image shows the broad plant ribbon, low waterline piers, long guide walls and low banks.
